default.speaker: OLD MAN ELAM
default.text: AH... A TUNER. I HAVEN'T SEEN ONE IN YEARS. THE STILLNESS TOOK MOST OF YOUR KIND.

default.speaker: OLD MAN ELAM
default.text: LISTEN CAREFULLY. THE GREAT TUNING FORK IN THE NORTH DUNGEON HAS GONE SILENT. WITHOUT ITS RESONANCE... EVERYTHING FADES.

default.speaker: OLD MAN ELAM
default.text: YOU WILL NEED THE ECHO. A BOOMERANG THAT CAN AWAKEN THE SOUND-CRYSTALS. FIND IT IN THE WESTERN WOODS.

default.speaker: OLD MAN ELAM
default.text: THE VILLAGE TO THE SOUTH HAS A BLACKSMITH AND A SHOP. STOCK UP BEFORE YOU VENTURE FURTHER.

default.speaker: OLD MAN ELAM
default.text: BE CAREFUL, MEHDI. THE BAMBOOS WERE ONCE PEOPLE. THE STILLNESS HOLLOWED THEM OUT. THEY FEEL NOTHING NOW.

quest_complete.speaker: OLD MAN ELAM
quest_complete.text: YOU FOUND THE ECHO! GOOD. NOW STRIKE THE SOUND-CRYSTALS AND FOLLOW THE RESONANCE TO THE NORTH DUNGEON.

quest_complete.speaker: OLD MAN ELAM
quest_complete.text: THE RACCOON GUARDIAN BLOCKS THE WESTERN PATH. IT WAS ONCE A PROTECTOR... NOW IT SERVES THE STILLNESS.

quest_complete.speaker: OLD MAN ELAM
quest_complete.text: SPEAK TO THE VILLAGE ELDER KAELEN. HE KNOWS MORE ABOUT THE TUNING FORK THAN ANYONE ALIVE.

default.speaker: SILENT GUARD
default.text: ...THE PATH... IS SEALED...

default.speaker: SILENT GUARD
default.text: BRING... THE ECHO... ONLY ITS RESONANCE... CAN OPEN... THIS GATE...

quest_complete.speaker: SILENT GUARD
quest_complete.text: ...YOU CARRY... THE ECHO...

quest_complete.speaker: SILENT GUARD
quest_complete.text: THE PATH... OPENS... GO... BEFORE THE STILLNESS... TAKES ME TOO...

default.text: HEY! HEY YOU! DONT EVEN THINK ABOUT IT!

default.speaker: THE POT
default.text: I SAW WHAT YOU DID TO MY COUSINS IN THE OTHER ROOM. SAVAGES. ALL OF YOU TUNERS ARE THE SAME.

default.speaker: THE POT
default.text: JUST WALK AWAY. THERE IS NOTHING INSIDE ME. DEFINITELY NOT A HEART. NOPE. NOTHING.

quest_complete.speaker: THE POT
quest_complete.text: OH GREAT. YOURE BACK. LISTEN, I HEARD YOU BEAT THE RACCOON. VERY IMPRESSIVE.

quest_complete.speaker: THE POT
quest_complete.text: FINE. TAKE WHAT IS INSIDE ME. BUT KNOW THAT I WILL HAUNT YOUR INVENTORY FOREVER.

default.speaker: ELDER KAELEN
default.text: WELCOME TO RESONANCE VILLAGE, YOUNG TUNER. I AM KAELEN, KEEPER OF THE OLD SONGS.

default.speaker: ELDER KAELEN
default.text: THE STILLNESS BEGAN THREE WINTERS AGO. FIRST THE BIRDS STOPPED SINGING. THEN THE RIVERS STOPPED FLOWING. NOW EVEN THE WIND IS DYING.

default.speaker: ELDER KAELEN
default.text: THE GREAT TUNING FORK IN THE NORTHERN DUNGEON WAS THE HEART OF ALL SOUND IN THIS LAND. SOMEONE... OR SOMETHING... SILENCED IT.

default.speaker: ELDER KAELEN
default.text: WE CALLED IT THE SILENCE GUARDIAN. IT WAS CREATED BY THE STILLNESS TO PROTECT THE FORK FROM BEING REAWAKENED.

default.speaker: ELDER KAELEN
default.text: YOU ARE THE LAST TUNER. IF YOU CANNOT RESTORE THE RESONANCE... THIS WORLD WILL BECOME NOTHING BUT EMPTY SILENCE.

default.speaker: ELDER KAELEN
default.text: VISIT THE BLACKSMITH. HE CAN STRENGTHEN YOUR WEAPONS. AND THE SHOP HAS SUPPLIES YOU WILL NEED.

quest_complete.speaker: ELDER KAELEN
quest_complete.text: YOU... YOU DEFEATED THE SILENCE GUARDIAN? THE RESONANCE... I CAN FEEL IT RETURNING.

quest_complete.speaker: ELDER KAELEN
quest_complete.text: LISTEN... CAN YOU HEAR IT? THE WIND IS HUMMING AGAIN. THE WORLD IS REMEMBERING HOW TO SING.

quest_complete.speaker: ELDER KAELEN
quest_complete.text: YOU HAVE SAVED US ALL, MEHDI. THE TUNERS WILL BE REMEMBERED. AND YOU... YOU WILL BE A LEGEND.

default.speaker: VILLAGE GUARD
default.text: HALT. THE ROADS BEYOND THE VILLAGE ARE DANGEROUS. THE BAMBOO HOLLOWS ROAM IN PACKS.

default.speaker: VILLAGE GUARD
default.text: I USED TO BE A SOLDIER. NOW I GUARD THIS GATE. ITS ALL I CAN DO SINCE THE STILLNESS TOOK MY HEARING.

default.speaker: VILLAGE GUARD
default.text: IF YOU MUST GO... HEAD WEST FOR THE RACCOON DEN. EAST FOR THE DUNGEON. AND STOCK UP AT THE SHOP FIRST.

quest_complete.speaker: VILLAGE GUARD
quest_complete.text: YOU DEFEATED THE RACCOON? INCREDIBLE. MAYBE THERE IS HOPE FOR US AFTER ALL.

quest_complete.speaker: VILLAGE GUARD
quest_complete.text: THE PATH TO THE NORTH IS SAFER NOW. BUT THE DUNGEON... THAT IS ANOTHER MATTER ENTIRELY.

default.speaker: LITTLE SAYA
default.text: ARE YOU A REAL TUNER? MY GRANDMA SAYS TUNERS COULD MAKE MUSIC COME FROM THIN AIR!

default.speaker: LITTLE SAYA
default.text: I HAVE NEVER HEARD MUSIC. THE STILLNESS CAME BEFORE I WAS BORN. WHAT DOES IT SOUND LIKE?

default.speaker: LITTLE SAYA
default.text: GRANDMA SAYS IF YOU FIND THREE MUSHROOMS AND BRING THEM TO THE HERBALIST, SHE WILL MAKE SOMETHING SPECIAL!

quest_complete.speaker: LITTLE SAYA
quest_complete.text: THE ELDER SAYS YOU ARE GOING TO SAVE THE WORLD! THAT IS SO COOL!

quest_complete.speaker: LITTLE SAYA
quest_complete.text: WHEN THE MUSIC COMES BACK, WILL YOU PLAY A SONG FOR ME? I HAVE ALWAYS WANTED TO HEAR ONE.

default.speaker: HERBALIST WREN
default.text: AH, HELLO THERE. I STUDY THE PLANTS THAT STILL GROW DESPITE THE STILLNESS.

default.speaker: HERBALIST WREN
default.text: MUSHROOMS ARE FASCINATING. THEY DONT NEED SOUND TO GROW. PERHAPS THAT IS WHY THEY THRIVE.

default.speaker: HERBALIST WREN
default.text: BRING ME MUSHROOMS AND FLOWERS AND I CAN TEACH YOU ABOUT THEIR PROPERTIES. THE BLACKSMITH CAN USE THEM TOO.

quest_complete.speaker: HERBALIST WREN
quest_complete.text: YOU HAVE GATHERED MANY MUSHROOMS! A TRUE FORAGER.

quest_complete.speaker: HERBALIST WREN
quest_complete.text: THE BLACKSMITH CAN USE FLOWERS TO MAKE HEALING SALVES. BRING HIM WHAT YOU HAVE AND HE WILL CRAFT THEM.

default.speaker: MOTHER LENA
default.text: MY HUSBAND WENT TO THE DUNGEON TO FIGHT THE SILENCE GUARDIAN THREE MONTHS AGO.

default.speaker: MOTHER LENA
default.text: HE NEVER CAME BACK. THE ELDER SAYS... THE STILLNESS TOOK HIM. TURNED HIM INTO ANOTHER HOLLOW.

default.speaker: MOTHER LENA
default.text: PLEASE... IF YOU GO TO THE DUNGEON... IF YOU SEE HIM... REMEMBER THAT HE WAS A GOOD MAN ONCE.

quest_complete.speaker: MOTHER LENA
quest_complete.text: YOU DEFEATED THE GUARDIAN? THEN... PERHAPS MY HUSBAND CAN FINALLY REST.

quest_complete.speaker: MOTHER LENA
quest_complete.text: THANK YOU, TUNER. I CAN ALMOST HEAR HIM HUMMING AGAIN. LIKE HE USED TO WHEN HE WORKED IN THE FIELDS.

default.speaker: MERCHANT ARLO
default.text: WELL WELL! A LIVING SOUL IN THESE CURSED WOODS. I AM ARLO, TRADER OF RARE GOODS.

default.speaker: MERCHANT ARLO
default.text: I TRAVEL FROM LAND TO LAND, BUT THE STILLNESS... IT FOLLOWS ME EVERYWHERE NOW.

default.speaker: MERCHANT ARLO
default.text: THE VILLAGE TO THE SOUTH HAS A PROPER SHOP. TELL NARA I SENT YOU. SHE OWES ME A DISCOUNT.

default.speaker: MERCHANT ARLO
default.text: WORD OF ADVICE: COLLECT STONES AND WOOD. THE BLACKSMITH PAYS WELL FOR THEM. AND YOU WILL NEED EVERY COIN.

quest_complete.speaker: MERCHANT ARLO
quest_complete.text: AH, THE ELDER SENT YOU? THEN YOU MUST BE THE ONE EVERYONE IS TALKING ABOUT.

quest_complete.speaker: MERCHANT ARLO
quest_complete.text: THE DUNGEON IN THE NORTH... I TRIED TO ENTER ONCE. THE SILENCE INSIDE IS SO THICK YOU CAN TASTE IT. BE READY.

default.speaker: SCHOLAR VERA
default.text: DO NOT BE ALARMED. I AM VERA, A SCHOLAR FROM THE EASTERN ACADEMY... WHAT REMAINS OF IT.

default.speaker: SCHOLAR VERA
default.text: I CAME HERE TO STUDY THE RESONANT PEAKS. THESE MOUNTAINS USED TO SING. NOW THEY ARE AS SILENT AS TOMBS.

default.speaker: SCHOLAR VERA
default.text: MY RESEARCH SUGGESTS THE TUNING FORK WAS NOT MERELY SILENCED. IT WAS INVERTED. IT NOW ABSORBS SOUND INSTEAD OF CREATING IT.

default.speaker: SCHOLAR VERA
default.text: THE SILENCE GUARDIAN IS THE KEY. DEFEAT IT, AND THE FORK SHOULD REVERSE ITS RESONANCE. IN THEORY.

quest_complete.speaker: SCHOLAR VERA
quest_complete.text: EXTRAORDINARY! THE RESONANCE IS RETURNING! MY INSTRUMENTS ARE DETECTING VIBRATIONS FOR THE FIRST TIME IN YEARS.

quest_complete.speaker: SCHOLAR VERA
quest_complete.text: YOU HAVE PROVEN MY THEORY CORRECT. THE FORK HAS BEEN RESTORED. HISTORY WILL REMEMBER THIS DAY.
